{
  "name": "supervisor-pane",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "description": "A side pane that lists subagent runs and chosen shell commands with their state and elapsed time.",
  "author": {
    "name": "i-noma-ru",
    "url": "https://github.com/i-noma-ru"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/i-noma-ru/claude-supervisor-pane",
  "repository": "https://github.com/i-noma-ru/claude-supervisor-pane",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "claude-code",
    "mod",
    "subagent",
    "pane",
    "ui"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "agents": {
      "type": "string",
      "multiple": true,
      "title": "Subagents to list",
      "description": "subagent_type values that get a row. Leave empty to list every subagent.",
      "default": []
    },
    "commands": {
      "type": "string",
      "multiple": true,
      "title": "Shell commands to list",
      "description": "Substrings; a Bash command containing one gets a row named after it. Leave empty to list no shell commands.",
      "default": []
    },
    "max_rows": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Maximum rows",
      "description": "Oldest finished rows are dropped beyond this count.",
      "default": 30,
      "min": 5,
      "max": 100
    }
  }
}
